notes.title: Parts change every time you play! New mode "Repair Shop".
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362581/8530d7aedafbcfb7cdad1f9467d0377ddbf41cb2.jpg

Thank you for playing "Chippy&Noppo".
We are pleased to announce the v1.2.0 update.
With this update, a new mode "Repair Shop" has been added!

Can work at the same stage many times "Repair Shop"
The themes which appear in "Repair Shop" are the toys which appeared in "Assembly Factory" until now.
But be careful, the parts changes each time!
Assemble same toys in different ways!
Some extra news for hardworkers! 
If you work hard in "Repair Shop", there is a chance of getting a new outfit or expanding "Secret Factory"!

You can work on "Repair Shop" after completion of all work in "Toy Factory" which is a section of "Assembly Factory".
Already finished you work? Then update this game's version.You can play straight away!

Simplified Chinese support
&English and Chinese voices added!
With this update, text now supports simplified Chinese characters!
Furthermore, changing the language now changes the voice to that language as well!
The language can be changed from "Option".


Enjoy working in your favorite mode!
Assemble favorite toys again and again in "Repair Shop".
Or assemble huge toys at "Secret Factory" which has been upgraded.

In addition, we have revised and adjusted the contents of some games.

Adjust the difficulty level of "Basic Review".
Adjust camera distance for some stages.
Fixed various defects.

We look forward to continue working with "Chippy&Noppo".

notes.title: Assemble toys freely with the parts you like. New mode "Secret Factory".
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Chippy&Noppo".
We are pleased to announce the v1.1.0 update.
With this update, a new mode "Secret Factory" has been added.

A playground for two "Secret Factory"
There is no fixed theme for the "Secret Factory".
You can make your own parts and assemble the toys freely.

In the beginning, there is only a few spaces and machines.
Advance the "Assembly Factory" and make the "Secret Factory" more and more powerful.
If you have already progressed through the "Assembly Factory", you can play in a spacious state from the beginning.

Once you have assembled your lovely toy, be sure to share it on social media with the hashtag #ChippyAndNoppo.

In addition, we have revised and adjusted the contents of some games.

Display controls when the number of players changed during play.
Fixed various defects.

We look forward to continue working with "Chippy&Noppo".

notes.title: "Chippy&Noppo" - v1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Chippy&Noppo".
We are pleased to announce the v1.0.1 update.
In this update, we have made the following fixes.

Fixed problems with the acquisition of some achievements.
A bug has been fixed where the following achievements could not be unlocked despite the conditions being met.
"Chippy&Noppo&You"
"Are you tired?"
"That was close!"
"Playful mindset to work"
"Chippy&Noppo&You&Your friend"

For those who were not able to unlock these achievements, you can now unlock it by fulfilling the conditions again.
Example:"Chippy&Noppo&You"
This can be unlocked by playing and clearing the "Basic Review" section from the "Choose  a Job" screen.

We apologise for the inconvenience.
We look forward to continue to work with "Chippy&Noppo".
